user_input: What is the objective of the Attendance Policy?
reference: The objective is to give employees provision to balance their personal as well as professional life.

user_input: Who is eligible under the Attendance Policy?
reference: The Attendance Policy applies to all regular employees, including Professional Staff and Labor Staff.

user_input: What are the office hours from Monday to Thursday?
reference: Monday to Thursday office hours are 09:00 am to 06:00 pm, with lunch and prayers from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm.

user_input: What are the office hours on Friday?
reference: Friday office hours are 09:00 am to 06:00 pm, with lunch and prayers from 1:00 pm to 2:30 pm.

user_input: What are the Saturday working hours for the Operations Department?
reference: Saturday working hours for the Operations Department are 10:00 am to 5:00 pm, with lunch and prayers from 1:00 pm to 2:00 pm.

user_input: How many WFH days are employees allowed per month according to the Attendance Policy?
reference: Employees are allowed to work remotely for 4 days per month upon manager approval.

user_input: Can unused WFH days be carried over?
reference: Unused WFH days cannot be carried over to the next month or year.

user_input: How much grace time is allowed for late arrival?
reference: Official working hours start at 09:00 hours, with a grace period of 30 minutes until 09:30 hours.

user_input: What happens after more than three late arrivals?
reference: More than 3 late arrivals are considered as one LWOP with a written warning, subject to the authority of the COO, CEO, CIO and HR.

user_input: When should an employee inform the supervisor and HR about WFH?
reference: For WFH, the employee needs to inform the supervisor and HR one day before the meeting or WFH plan via ESS.

user_input: What is the purpose of the Leave Policy?
reference: The purpose is to provide guidelines regarding when to avail leave and the process for taking leave with pay, leave without pay, and leave of absence.

user_input: Who is eligible under the Leave Policy?
reference: The Leave Policy applies to all regular employees of the company.

user_input: What software is used to maintain leave records?
reference: All leave records of employees are maintained in MiHCM software.

user_input: What should an employee do if emergency leave cannot be applied for in advance?
reference: The employee should give telephonic or text intimation to the immediate manager or HR department.

user_input: Can leave be claimed as a matter of right?
reference: No. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right and may be granted or refused depending upon business demands.

user_input: What is the leave calendar year?
reference: The leave calendar year is from July to June.

user_input: When do employees become eligible for sick and casual leave?
reference: Employees become eligible for Sick and Casual Leave after completion of the probationary period.

user_input: When are employees eligible for annual leave?
reference: Employees are eligible for Annual Leave after one year of service.

user_input: Who must approve leave before an employee proceeds on leave?
reference: The Head of Department, Reporting Manager, and Human Resources Department must approve the leave before the employee proceeds on leave.

user_input: What happens if an employee takes leave without approval?
reference: Leave without approval is considered leave without pay, and absence without proper approval may lead to disciplinary action.

user_input: How many sick leave days are employees entitled to?
reference: Employees are entitled to 8 days of sick leave.

user_input: Is sick leave paid?
reference: Yes. Sick leave is paid leave.

user_input: What is the maximum number of casual leave days that can be taken at one time?
reference: A maximum of 2 casual leave days can be availed at one time.

user_input: What happens if casual leave is taken from Friday to Monday?
reference: Leave taken from Friday to Monday is treated as sandwich leave and is deducted from casual leave. If casual leave is unavailable, salary is deducted accordingly.

user_input: How long is maternity leave?
reference: Confirmed female employees are entitled to maternity leave with full pay for 90 continuous days, excluding national holidays, for each pregnancy.

user_input: When are employees eligible for maternity leave?
reference: Employees are entitled to maternity leave upon completion of probation.

user_input: How many paternity leave days can an employee take?
reference: A maximum of 3 days of paternity leave can be availed.

user_input: When must paternity leave be taken?
reference: Paternity leave must be taken within 10 days of childbirth; otherwise the leave will lapse.

user_input: How many pilgrimage leave days are available?
reference: An employee who has completed one year of continuous service is entitled to 14 days of pilgrimage leave.

user_input: How often can pilgrimage leave be availed?
reference: Pilgrimage leave can be availed once during two years of service.

user_input: Who is eligible for the Work From Home Policy?
reference: Professional employees who have completed 3 months of employment, whose roles can be effectively managed remotely, and who have a track record of meeting performance goals and deadlines are eligible.

user_input: How many WFH days are allowed per year?
reference: Employees are allowed to work remotely for 48 days per year, equivalent to 4 days per month, subject to manager approval.

user_input: Can additional WFH days be approved?
reference: Additional WFH days may require special written approval from management, including the COO, CEO, or CIO.

user_input: How far in advance must a WFH request be submitted?
reference: All WFH requests must be submitted at least 1 day in advance using the designated company portal.

user_input: On which days can WFH be availed?
reference: WFH can be availed on any working day except Monday and Friday.

user_input: Can unused WFH days be carried forward?
reference: Unused WFH days cannot be carried over to the next month or year.

user_input: What security requirements apply when working from home?
reference: Employees must use a secure internet connection, comply with company cybersecurity protocols, access sensitive company data only through VPN or approved security platforms, and keep software and devices updated.

user_input: What are employees expected to do during WFH working hours?
reference: Employees are expected to maintain full availability during regular working hours and remain responsive through company communication channels such as email, Slack, and phone.

user_input: Can WFH privileges be revoked?
reference: Yes. WFH privileges may be revoked at management's discretion if performance issues arise.

user_input: Can an employee work remotely from outside the country?
reference: Working remotely from outside the country may require additional approval because of tax, visa, and legal considerations, and employees must comply with local labor laws.
